Day trips

The Var & Provence

Hilltop villages, lavender fields, spectacular gorges and a wild coastline — Provence in all its diversity, within easy reach of Cassis.

From 30 min to 2h, depending on the destination

Cassis is an ideal base for exploring Provence. Less than an hour away, the Var coast reveals its characterful villages. Venture a little further and the lavender fields of Valensole, the Gorges du Verdon, the villages of the Luberon and the City of Popes make for unforgettable excursions.

30 — 60 min

The Var coast

Hilltop villages, fishing ports and vineyards — the Var is Provence just as you imagine it.

Our favourite

Le Castellet

A medieval hilltop village with stunning views over the Bandol vineyards and the sea. Cobbled lanes, craft workshops, a 12th-century church. One of the most beautiful villages in the region.

30 min from Cassis — Free parking below the village

La Cadière d'Azur

A hilltop village next to Le Castellet, less touristy but just as charming. Panoramic views over the Bay of Bandol, flower-filled lanes and excellent restaurants. The heart of the Bandol appellation.

30 min from Cassis — Combine it with Le Castellet

Sanary-sur-Mer

A colourful, lively fishing port with traditional ‘pointu’ boats and a Provençal market (Wednesday's is breathtaking). Diving, strolls around the harbour and seafood cuisine.

40 min from Cassis — Market on Wednesday mornings
1h from Cassis

Bormes-les-Mimosas & Le Lavandou

Bormes, a flower-decked village clinging to the hillside, is a gem of the Var coast. Le Lavandou, just below, has 12 fine sandy beaches and access to the Îles d'Hyères (Porquerolles, Port-Cros).

Ferries to Porquerolles from Le Lavandou

1h30 — 2h

Further afield in Provence

For the days when you're in the mood for adventure — excursions that are worth every kilometre.

1h30 from Cassis

Avignon, City of Popes

The Palais des Papes, the largest Gothic palace in the world, the Pont d'Avignon and the medieval ramparts. In July, the famous Festival d'Avignon turns the city into an open-air stage.

Palais des Papes
Our favourite

The villages of the Luberon

Gordes, listed among the ‘Most Beautiful Villages of France’, with its tumbling stone houses. Roussillon and its blazing ochre cliffs. Bonnieux and its views over the valley. An unforgettable day trip.

1h30 from Cassis — Allow a full day
2h from Cassis

The Gorges du Verdon

Europe's ‘Grand Canyon’. 700-metre cliffs, the turquoise water of the Lac de Sainte-Croix, kayaking, hiking and the dizzying Route des Crêtes. A breathtaking natural spectacle.

Kayaking, pedalos and swimming at the Lac de Sainte-Croix
Seasonal

The Valensole plateau

From mid-June to late August, the plateau is covered in an ocean of mauve lavender as far as the eye can see. Heady scents, distilleries, farmers' markets. The ideal time: late June to mid-July, for the full bloom.

1h30 from Cassis — Mid-June to late August only
